description: Check text contrast against the WCAG AA threshold (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text); the AAA verdict is shown only when you pass level: "AAA". Either pass a `foreground` / `background` color pair, or pass `url` + `selector` to read the element's own text color, background (composited from the nearest painted ancestors), font size and weight from the live page; explicit colors win over the page. A gradient or image background is reported as an error, never a guessed ratio. When it fails, suggests BRAND-aligned replacements — extracts the actual brand palette from the `url` page using our scanner (CSS vars + most-used colors), or use a provided `brandColors` array. No `url` and no `brandColors` = ratio + pass/fail only. NOTE: on this HOSTED server, localhost and private addresses are refused — it runs in our cloud and cannot reach your machine. Two ways to scan a local dev server: run the MCP locally (`npx -y @webability/mcp`, simplest — nothing leaves the machine), or open a tunnel (`webability-tunnel --port 3000`) and pass its URL as `url` together with the printed secret as `tunnel_secret`.

background.description: Background color (hex or rgb). Optional with url + selector.

brandColors.description: Pre-supplied brand palette. Skips URL extraction if provided.

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

fontSize.description: Font size in px (default 16, or the element's computed size with url + selector)

foreground.description: Foreground color (hex or rgb). Optional with url + selector.

isBold.description: Whether text is bold (default false, or the element's computed weight with url + selector)

level.description: Conformance level to judge. Default "AA". "AAA" adds the enhanced-contrast (1.4.6) verdict and AAA palette suggestions.

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

selector.description: CSS selector of the text element on `url` (e.g. the `selector` from a scan_page issue)

tunnel_secret.description: Secret printed by `webability-tunnel`. Required when `url` is a tunnel URL; the URL alone will be refused by the relay. Ignored otherwise.

url.description: Live page: with `selector`, the colors are read from that element; on a failing pair, the brand palette is extracted from it (uses our scanner — CSS vars + dominant colors).
